# landerpilot-mcp

> Universal Node.js stdio bridge and setup package for LanderPilot Cloud MCP.

## What it does

- Connects stdio MCP clients to `https://landerpilot.com/api/mcp`.
- Configures Trae, Cursor, Claude, VS Code, Codex, CodeWhale, OpenCode, or a generic MCP client.
- Verifies remote connectivity by calling `listTools`.
- Exposes local site/template inspection and deployment-handoff helpers.

## Install

```bash
npm install -g landerpilot-mcp
landerpilot-mcp-setup --client cursor
landerpilot-mcp-doctor --client cursor
```

Persistent setup requires the global install. Trae defaults to a user-level config. Project/custom configs containing a plaintext API Key are refused unless `--allow-project-secret` is explicit. Setup does not edit `.gitignore`.
